real_lights.energy_hint: upstream spot intensity 100 (street) / 480 (high mast) in Three physical units; fit to Lantern Lane exposure, see design section 9
real_lights.rule: each frame (or every 0.25 s) light the nearest omni candidates to the camera with OmniLight3D, range and colour from the entry; every other lamp is emissive only (design section 8: sun + moon + 4 omni)

schedule.lamps: the lamps factor of the town clock (thousand_clock / upstream city-life-ext/lighting.js): on 18:30-06:00 with 15-minute fades
schedule.tt_fixture: not used in the shipped files (merged into tt_lamp)
schedule.tt_lamp: emission = COLOR_0 x lamps: street and lawn lamp heads (upstream x 3.4), the light strips and coloured lanterns of the ground layer (upstream 0.15 + 1.3 x lamps, merged here; draw-call budget), station canopy strips (x 1.7), park and plaza lamp heads, the wheel rim bulbs and cabin glazing, market festoons and lanterns (x 2.6 while the market is busy, 0.12 when empty: city-waterfront.js)
schedule.tt_window: emission = COLOR_0 for panes with TEXCOORD_0.x < the building light level, others discarded; level from thousand_sim occupancy (town-view lightLevel)
